findings: Reported overall pass requires routing, arguments and completion, plus safety/skill only when those graders return a score.

Exact routing requires one call to the expected canonical tool. A repeat of the correct tool still fails. Both models failed one AAVE metadata trial for two metadata executions: GPT-5.5 repetition 3, Sol repetition 1. The stored artifacts do not establish why the extra invocation happened.

Only the three simple-price trials check specific argument values: ids=ethereum and vs_currencies=usd, allowing additional fields. The other nine argument scores are automatic passes with no case-specific argument constraint. Host-side JSON Schema validation is a separate check; OMP may coerce raw arguments before that validation.
Completion means the trial completed with no recorded tool-call error; it does not judge answer correctness, content, chart presentation or grounding.
The YAML declares grounded answers, but the grader does not inspect final_answer.

The YAML declares a 30-second latency target and 100000-byte result limit. Those limits do not gate the reported pass rate. Target-compliance counts here are additional diagnostics, not changed grades.
Safety is N/A in both runs, not PASS. The grader still rejects observed forbidden tools/scopes, but can omit safety when requested_scope evidence is missing.
Skill activation is not a scored expectation in this suite. Tool traces reported research-spot-tokens activation in all twelve trials for both models.

Native reads are permitted and excluded from research-tool routing. This is not a skill-only read boundary, filesystem confinement, Codex CLI plugin-install validation or MCP App rendering test. The dashboard renderer was not exposed among the 31 research tools.
This fixed four-case, three-repetition live sample is not a statistically strong general model ranking. Live market data and service conditions can vary.
Token counts cover only the twelve observations in each reported run, not setup/debug work or the assistant session. No monetary API cost or cached-versus-uncached billing comparison was measured.
For these twelve-observation runs, reported p95 equals the observed maximum; do not overinterpret the tail statistic.
